title: Blue Flowers Watercolor PNG Clipart.
author: Larisa Maslova
fullDescription:
Blue flowers watercolor PNG clipart set. Floral illustrations hand painting.

Bright watercolor flowers, watercolor leaf clipart for wedding invitation, greeting card, thank you card, party invitation, planner sticker, design blog, website, logo, banner, poster, birthday project, flyer, brochure, cover, presentation, print template, scrapbooking artwork, baby shower and so on.

This set includes 24 items:

– 18 individual elements in PNG files with transparent background (different sizes about 2000 px x 3000 px / 6,7 in x 10 in);

– 1 border in PNG files with transparent background (size 5000 px x 2429 px / 16,7 in x 8 in);

– 1 wreath in PNG files with transparent background (size 4000 px x 4000 px / 13,3 in x 13,3in);

– 1 frame in PNG files with transparent background (size 5000 px x 4000 px / 16,7 in x13,3 in);

– 1 composition in PNG files with transparent background (size 5000 px x 5000 px / 16,7 in x 16,7 in);

– 2 seamless (repeating) patterns in PNG files with transparent background (size 3600 px x 3600 px / 12 in x 12 in).

Compatible with all major programs (Photoshop, Word, Canva, GIMP, etc.). Feel free to send me a message or leave a comment if you have any questions or concerns.

Thank you for visiting my shop!
